messages:
sara: Heads-up — Pagerflow -> incident-bot roundtrip shows 200s but pages not delivered to oncall since ~08:10 UTC. Customer-facing alerts delayed. Investigating now.

ops-bot: Automated alert: pager-connector queue depth spike detected at 08:09:58 UTC (depth=124, processing_rate=0.4/s) :warning:

kevin: I'm oncall, I got nothing. I can confirm incident-bot logs show HTTP 200 for the webhook POSTs. paging provider API shows intermittent 5xx around same window.

marta: Any chance webhook auth rotated? last deploy touched pager-connector yesterday. Can someone paste the connector logs?

sara: grabbing logs - looks like worker thread stuck on a rate-limit backoff loop, not requeuing. snippet:

```
2026-03-17T08:09:56Z worker-3 ERROR backoff exceeded for msg_id=abc123 delay=120s
2026-03-17T08:09:57Z worker-3 INFO received 200 from incident-bot for payload=... but provider_response=502
2026-03-17T08:10:02Z worker-3 WARN not draining queue due to stuck semaphore
```

kevin: That 200 is incident-bot acking receipt, not delivery to carrier. carrier 502 explains no SMS. Can we switch to backup carrier (provider-b) while we heal provider-a?

andrew: I can flip traffic to provider-b via the feature-flag toggles in the control plane. Recommend short maintenance window and notify impacted customers.

marta: Runbook step 4: restart connector worker and flush queue. If queue depth > 100, perform controlled requeue into backup provider.

sara: Restarting worker now: `systemctl restart pager-connector@3` — will monitor queue. :spinner:

ops-bot: Action: restart requested by sara at 08:12:05 UTC.

sara: Worker restarted. Queue depth dropping (124 -> 12) but about ~110 messages still pending; requeuing to backup provider now.

kevin: Noted customer impact: two enterprise tenants reported delayed pages within the 08:09–08:18 window. No missed acknowledgements stored, but delays could have impacted SLA. Marking Sev2 for now.

marta: Executing provider switch command: `rbacctl toggle-pager-provider --target=provider-b --scope=org:all --dry-run=false`

incident-bot: provider switch executed. Rolling over outbound provider to provider-b for orgs: enterprise-*. Took effect at 08:14:30 UTC.

andrew: Requeued ~110 messages to provider-b, delivery rate normalizing. carrier success responses now 200 and SMS delivery receipts coming back.

sara: Confirming: all pending messages requeued, no duplicates observed, and oncall confirmations received. Root cause looks like transient carrier outage + connector backoff logic that failed to escalate to alternate provider.

kevin: Ops notes: immediate mitigation = restart connector, requeue to backup provider, toggle feature-flag. Customer comms: brief status update to affected accounts.

marta: Postmortem action items: (1) failover automation for provider 5xx (2) decrease max backoff ceiling (3) add synthetic end-to-end paging smoke every 5m for enterprise orgs.

sara: I'll own the runbook and follow-up. Creating incident ticket with timeline and impact numbers. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated) at 08:18:20 UTC. Follow-up: schedule postmortem and retro.

kevin: Leaving a note — customer success pinged affected accounts, they acknowledged delayed but received pages. Lowering to Sev3 if no escalation within 24h.

marta: putting a short-term monitor in: `alert if pager-connector.queue_depth > 50 for 3m`

sara: will add the above monitor and attach logs to the incident. Closing thread for now.
